dossier.purpose: Python monorepo for an open-source agent harness built on LangChain `create_agent` / LangGraph (libs/ARCHITECTURE.md:12-30). Packages: `deepagents` SDK (`create_deep_agent`: planning/sub-agent/filesystem/shell/memory/skills middleware over pluggable backends), `deepagents-code` (`dcode` terminal coding agent: Textual TUI, headless `-n` mode, remote sandboxes, MCP client), `deepagents-acp` (Agent Client Protocol adapter), `deepagents-talon` (experimental alpha host for chat channels and cron), `deepagents-evals` (pytest evals plus Harbor/DRBench adapters) and partner packages (Daytona, Modal, Runloop, Vercel sandboxes; QuickJS REPL). All model access goes through LangChain chat-model packages; no vendor harness SDK (OpenAI Agents/Codex SDK, Claude Agent SDK) is used (searched). The tree names `gpt-5.6-sol` and `gpt-6-astra` but no 'GPT-6.1 Sol' identifier.

claims.claim: Deep Agents is an open source agent harness — an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece.
Model-agnostic — works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local.
Production-ready — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith.
Sub-agents — delegate tasks to agents with isolated context windows.
Filesystem — read, write, edit, or search over pluggable local, sandboxed, or remote backends.
Shell access — run commands in your sandbox of choice.
Persistent memory — pluggable state and store backends for cross-session recall.
Human-in-the-loop — approve, edit, or reject tool calls before they run.
Tools — bring your own functions or any MCP server.
Deep Agents Code — a pre-built coding agent in your terminal, similar to Claude Code or Cursor, powered by any LLM; install with `curl -LsSf https://langch.in/dcode | bash`.
Quickstart: `uv add deepagents`, then `create_deep_agent(model='openai:gpt-6-astra', tools=[...], system_prompt=...)` and `agent.invoke(...)`.
Can I use this in production? Yes! Built on LangGraph, designed for production agent deployments; pair it with LangSmith for tracing, evaluation and monitoring.
Deep Agents follows a 'trust the LLM' model. The agent can do anything its tools allow. Enforce boundaries at the tool/sandbox level, not by expecting the model to self-police.
dcode adds remote sandboxes (LangSmith, AgentCore, Daytona, Modal, Runloop, & more) and a headless mode for scripting and CI; do not run it in an untrusted directory without a sandbox backend.

integrations.mcp: MCP client only. dcode loads MCP servers via `--mcp-config` / `.mcp.json` (libs/code/deepagents_code/main.py:2761-2777; libs/code/deepagents_code/mcp_tools.py; deps fastmcp/mcp, libs/code/pyproject.toml:92,105) and Talon does too (libs/talon/README.md:550-552). No MCP server exposed by this repo (no FastMCP server code found) and the SDK package contains no MCP code. Root .mcp.json only points contributors' tooling at LangChain docs servers (.mcp.json:1-12).
integrations.sdk_or_api: Python SDK: `create_deep_agent` returns a LangGraph CompiledStateGraph (libs/deepagents/deepagents/__init__.py:4-7,45; graph.py:272-292); JS/TS is a separate repo (README.md:44). HTTP: dcode starts a local `langgraph dev` server (127.0.0.1, HTTP+SSE, auth noop; libs/code/THREAT_MODEL.md:66,232); `AsyncSubAgent` launches background runs on remote Agent Protocol servers (libs/deepagents/deepagents/middleware/async_subagents.py:1-10). ACP over stdio via `dcode --acp` (main.py:2871-2875; libs/acp/README.md:137-175). Composite GitHub Action (action.yml:164-165). The `deepagents deploy` CLI used by examples/deploy-* is not implemented in this tree (examples/deploy-coding-agent/README.md:17).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: No integration that drives Claude Code or Codex as a worker. Interop in dcode (code-level, marked experimental): reads `~/.claude/skills` and `.claude/skills` (libs/code/deepagents_code/_paths.py:369-377; agent.py:2506-2517), recognizes `.claude-plugin` / `.codex-plugin` manifests (libs/code/deepagents_code/plugins/manifest.py:23-24), `.mcp.json` follows Claude Code's format (mcp_tools.py:397). `openai_codex` provider signs in with ChatGPT OAuth (libs/code/deepagents_code/model_config.py:1018-1024; integrations/openai_codex.py:1-34). SDK has a built-in Codex harness profile for openai:gpt-5.1/5.2/5.3-codex (libs/deepagents/deepagents/profiles/harness/_openai_codex.py:27-31). dcode cannot use Claude Pro/Max/Claude Code subscriptions, only pay-as-you-go API keys (libs/code/deepagents_code/tui/widgets/auth.py:1093-1095).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No analytics/telemetry SDK found in libs sources (searched posthog/sentry/mixpanel/segment/opentelemetry; hits were lockfiles and internal trace-tag helpers, e.g. libs/code/deepagents_code/auto_mode.py:1051-1094). Outbound traffic: (1) the chosen LLM provider API (required); `openai:` models default to the OpenAI Responses API, which retains data server-side unless `store=False` (libs/deepagents/deepagents/graph.py:324-334; profiles/provider/_openai.py:21-24; libs/deepagents/THREAT_MODEL.md:35). (2) LangSmith: `langsmith` is a hard SDK dependency (libs/deepagents/pyproject.toml:27) and runs carry `ls_integration`/`lc_versions` metadata (graph.py:974-982) that leaves the host only if tracing is on; Talon tracing is opt-in (libs/talon/README.md:482-492); in dcode, storing a LangSmith key via `/auth` turns tracing on unless `DEEPAGENTS_CODE_LANGSMITH_TRACING=false` (libs/code/deepagents_code/config.py:1736-1804). (3) dcode defaults, all opt-out: PyPI update check and auto-update (update_check.py:4423-4477; config_manifest.py:3055-3074; env DEEPAGENTS_CODE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK / DEEPAGENTS_CODE_AUTO_UPDATE=0), hourly un-checksummed pricing-catalog fetch from raw.githubusercontent.com (cost_tracking.py:745-751; libs/code/THREAT_MODEL.md:552-557), plugin auto-update (config_manifest.py:3044-3053), SHA-256-verified ripgrep download from github.com (THREAT_MODEL.md:545-550). `DEEPAGENTS_CODE_OFFLINE` covers ripgrep, pricing and plugins (managed_tools.py:280; cost_tracking.py:767; plugins/discovery.py:349) but update_check.py never references it. (4) The installer fetches uv from astral.sh with only structural checks (libs/code/scripts/install.sh:79-81,1613). Accounts/services needed: a key per model provider; Tavily key for `web_search` (libs/code/deepagents_code/tools.py:302-313); a provider account for each remote sandbox (integrations/sandbox_registry.py:38-79; libs/talon/README.md:42); a LangGraph/Agent Protocol server for async sub-agents; LangSmith for the deploy examples (examples/deploy-coding-agent/README.md:5-12).

code.architecture: Layers: LangGraph (state, checkpoints, interrupts) -> LangChain `create_agent` -> Deep Agents harness (libs/ARCHITECTURE.md:12-30). SDK libs/deepagents/deepagents/: `graph.py` assembles middleware, sub-agents and prompt, then calls `create_agent` with `checkpointer`/`store` passthrough and `recursion_limit` 9,999 (graph.py:961-983); `middleware/` (filesystem.py: file tools, path permissions, large-result eviction; subagents.py; async_subagents.py: remote Agent Protocol tasks; skills.py; memory.py; summarization.py; rubric.py: grader loop; patch_tool_calls.py); `backends/` (protocol.py; state.py thread-scoped default; store.py; filesystem.py; local_shell.py host shell with no isolation; sandbox.py BaseSandbox; langsmith.py LangSmithSandbox; composite.py; context_hub.py); `profiles/` (OpenAI Responses-API provider profile; harness profiles for Anthropic Opus 4.7/Sonnet 4.6/Haiku 4.5, Nemotron 3 Ultra, OpenAI Codex 5.1-5.3; _builtin_profiles.py:149-156). dcode libs/code/deepagents_code/: main.py (CLI), app.py (Textual TUI), agent.py (`create_cli_agent`), client/non_interactive.py (headless), client/launch/server.py + client/remote_client.py (local langgraph dev server + HTTP/SSE client), server_graph.py, integrations/sandbox_factory.py + sandbox_registry.py (agentcore/daytona/langsmith/modal/runloop/vercel), sessions.py (SQLite sessions.db, UUIDv7 thread ids), mcp_tools.py, tools.py (Tavily `web_search`, SSRF-guarded `fetch_url`), hooks/, plugins/, extensions/, update_check.py, cost_tracking.py. Talon libs/talon/deepagents_talon/: host.py, runtime.py, channels/ (Discord/Slack/Telegram/WhatsApp), cron/, sandbox.py, archive*/history* modules. Also libs/acp (ACP), libs/partners/* (sandbox providers; quickjs REPL middleware), libs/evals (pytest evals, deepagents_harbor, harbor_adapters/{drbench,contextbench}).
code.packaging_and_release: Per-package PyPI releases driven by release-please (.github/RELEASING.md:19-25) and .github/workflows/release.yml: `uv build` (release.yml:396-398; SDK uses setuptools, pyproject.toml:70-72; dcode uses hatchling with a build hook stamping the release commit, libs/code/pyproject.toml:194-196, release.yml:400-402) -> artifact upload -> pre-release checks (wheel import + `make test`; integration tests disabled via `if: false`, release.yml:816-821) -> TestPyPI -> PyPI via Trusted Publishing OIDC with pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish pinned by SHA and `print-hash: true`, but `attestations: false` (release.yml:847-893) -> GitHub Release via ncipollo/release-action attaching `dist/*` under tag `<pkg>==<version>` (release.yml:949-961). No checksum files, signatures, SBOM or provenance steps found in workflows. Versions at this commit: deepagents 0.7.21, deepagents-code 0.1.79, deepagents-acp 0.0.12, deepagents-talon 0.0.8, langchain-daytona 0.0.8, langchain-modal 0.0.6, langchain-runloop 0.0.7, langchain-vercel-sandbox 0.0.2, langchain-quickjs 0.3.8 (.release-please-manifest.json:1-11); deepagents-evals 0.0.1 is in the release dropdown (release.yml:34) but not the manifest. Actions are pinned to commit SHAs (AGENTS.md:137). dcode's installer also provisions a pinned, SHA-256-verified ripgrep (install.sh:71-77).
code.tests_and_ci: pytest (asyncio auto mode, xdist, timeout, socket-blocking `--disable-socket`, benchmark/CodSpeed), ruff (select ALL) and `ty`; warnings are errors (libs/deepagents/pyproject.toml:135-155; libs/deepagents/Makefile:19-21); Node `node --test` for the WhatsApp bridge. Network-free tests live in tests/unit_tests, networked ones in tests/integration_tests (AGENTS.md:81). Workflows (.github/workflows, ~60 files): ci.yml path-filtered lint + test per package (SDK on Python 3.11-3.14 ubuntu plus Windows 3.13; code/talon 3.12-3.14; evals 3.12-3.13; acp/partners 3.11-3.14; ci.yml:234-414), reusable _test.yml (`make test`, ripgrep, clean-tree check) and _lint.yml (`make lint`), ci.yml also builds the DRBench dataset and runs helper-script tests (ci.yml:495-569); check_* gates (lockfiles, extras sync, SDK pin, versions, release deps), PR label/scope gates, integration_tests.yml (manual dispatch with live API keys, integration_tests.yml:5), eval workflows (evals.yml, harbor.yml, unified_evals.yml, clbench.yml), release.yml, release-please.yml. No macOS runner.

claim_checks.claim: Model-agnostic — works with any LLM that supports tool calling (README.md:30); dcode 'powered by any LLM' (README.md:47)
claim_checks.evidence: Any `provider:model` string or BaseChatModel is accepted and resolved through LangChain `init_chat_model` (libs/deepagents/deepagents/_models.py:35-57; dcode `create_model` accepts arbitrary specs, libs/code/deepagents_code/config.py:6636-6687). But only langchain-anthropic and langchain-google-genai are hard SDK deps (libs/deepagents/pyproject.toml:22-30); other providers need extra LangChain packages (libs/code/pyproject.toml:108-136). Tuned built-in harness profiles exist only for Anthropic Opus 4.7/Sonnet 4.6/Haiku 4.5, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra and OpenAI Codex 5.1-5.3 (profiles/_builtin_profiles.py:149-156; harness/_openai_codex.py:27-31). dcode cannot use Claude subscriptions, only API keys (tui/widgets/auth.py:1093-1095). 'GPT-6.1 Sol' appears nowhere; nearest are gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-6-astra (tui/widgets/model_selector.py:108-112; README.md:59).

`create_deep_agent` is exported as shown (libs/deepagents/deepagents/__init__.py:4-7,45). `langchain-openai` is not an SDK runtime dependency (libs/deepagents/pyproject.toml:22-30; test group only, :61), so an `openai:` model needs a separate install (dcode bundles it, libs/code/pyproject.toml:43). The `openai:` prefix defaults to the Responses API (profiles/provider/_openai.py:21-24; graph.py:324-334), which retains data on OpenAI servers unless `store=False` is configured (libs/deepagents/THREAT_MODEL.md:35). `my_custom_tool` in the snippet is undefined. Behavior of init_chat_model when langchain-openai is missing lives in LangChain, not checked.

claim_checks.claim: Shell access — run commands in your sandbox of choice (README.md:38)
claim_checks.evidence: `SandboxBackendProtocol.execute/aexecute` (libs/deepagents/deepagents/backends/protocol.py:886-941), `BaseSandbox` (backends/sandbox.py:1536), `LangSmithSandbox` (backends/langsmith.py:56-95); partner packages for Daytona/Modal/Runloop/Vercel (libs/partners/*/pyproject.toml); dcode registry agentcore/daytona/langsmith/modal/runloop/vercel (libs/code/deepagents_code/integrations/sandbox_registry.py:38-79). Caveats: `LocalShellBackend` is unrestricted host execution (backends/local_shell.py:1-6,34-79); the default `StateBackend` has no shell (graph.py:297-303); the LangSmith sandbox SDK is flagged alpha (libs/deepagents/pyproject.toml:143-144).

claim_checks.claim: Tools — bring your own functions or any MCP server (README.md:42)
claim_checks.evidence: `create_deep_agent(tools=...)` takes any LangChain tool or callable (libs/deepagents/deepagents/graph.py:274). The SDK package has no MCP code (case-insensitive search of libs/deepagents/deepagents found no 'mcp'); MCP lives in dcode (libs/code/deepagents_code/mcp_tools.py; libs/code/pyproject.toml:92,105) and Talon (libs/talon/README.md:550-552). SDK users must adapt MCP tools to LangChain tools themselves.

claim_checks.claim: Production-ready — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing); persistent memory via pluggable state/store backends (README.md:31,39,83)
claim_checks.evidence: `checkpointer` and `store` are passed straight to `create_agent` (graph.py:968-969) and `StoreBackend`/`MemoryMiddleware` exist (backends/store.py; middleware/memory.py), but the default `StateBackend` is thread-scoped and ephemeral (backends/state.py:38-48) and the SDK ships no durable checkpointer; dcode uses SQLite (libs/code/deepagents_code/sessions.py:347-366). The SDK is classified Beta (libs/deepagents/pyproject.toml:11) and 0.7.0 shipped ~10 breaking changes (libs/deepagents/CHANGELOG.md:173-186). 'Production-ready' itself is not checkable.

claim_checks.claim: Sub-agents — delegate tasks to agents with isolated context windows (README.md:35)
claim_checks.evidence: Declarative sub-agents get their own middleware stack and run via the `task` tool (libs/deepagents/deepagents/graph.py:667-790,875-887); `CompiledSubAgent` and remote `AsyncSubAgent` are also supported (graph.py:414-450; middleware/async_subagents.py:34-77). Exception: `mode='fork'` (experimental) continues the parent's conversation instead of isolating (graph.py:428-431).

claim_checks.claim: dcode remote sandboxes: LangSmith, AgentCore, Daytona, Modal, Runloop & more (libs/code/README.md:39)
claim_checks.evidence: BUILTIN_METADATA lists agentcore, daytona, langsmith, modal, runloop, vercel (libs/code/deepagents_code/integrations/sandbox_registry.py:38-79); flags `--sandbox`, `--sandbox-id`, `--sandbox-setup` (main.py:2718-2751); extras (libs/code/pyproject.toml:139-145). An owned sandbox is deleted on exit; one attached via `--sandbox-id` is kept (integrations/sandbox_factory.py:142-182). All providers are hosted third-party services; no local container provider ships. Auto approval mode is unavailable with a sandbox (main.py:6483-6492).

claim_checks.claim: dcode headless mode for scripting and CI (libs/code/README.md:42); Action input `json` gives machine-readable output (action.yml:140-143; ACTION.md:41)
claim_checks.evidence: `-n` runs one task with no human approvals, shell off unless an allow-list is set; `--max-turns`, `--timeout` (exit 124), `--recursion-limit`, `--rubric` exist (libs/code/deepagents_code/main.py:2592-2687; client/non_interactive.py:2571-2700). But every headless run starts a fresh thread: `run_non_interactive` takes no resume/thread argument (main.py:1555-1556; non_interactive.py:2822) and `-r` is wired only to the TUI (main.py:6373,6515). `--max-turns` counts the initial stream plus HITL-resume passes (non_interactive.py:2291-2312). Top-level `--json` is consumed only by management commands (main.py:6122-6225; no `output_format` in non_interactive.py), so no code path was found that applies the Action's `json` input to `-n` output.

claim_checks.claim: 'Trust the LLM' model; enforce boundaries at the tool/sandbox level (README.md:112)
claim_checks.evidence: Consistent with code: `LocalShellBackend` gives unrestricted host execution (libs/deepagents/deepagents/backends/local_shell.py:34-79); the SDK provides no OS-level isolation (libs/deepagents/THREAT_MODEL.md:32); SDK tool exclusion 'is not a security surface' (middleware/_tool_exclusion.py:41-44); path `permissions` apply only to built-in filesystem tools (graph.py:487-490) and raise NotImplementedError with execute-capable backends unless scoped to composite routes (middleware/filesystem.py:1849-1856,620-635). dcode's shell allow-list checks only the first token (libs/code/THREAT_MODEL.md:565-569).

claim_checks.claim: Talon README: checkpoints in checkpoints.sqlite let chat history survive restarts (libs/talon/README.md:30) vs 'Conversation persistence is intentionally not durable yet' (README.md:844)
claim_checks.evidence: The README contradicts itself. Code wires `AsyncSqliteSaver` + `ConversationSaver` for model-backed hosts (libs/talon/deepagents_talon/__main__.py:317-330), while `DeepAgentRuntime` defaults to `InMemorySaver` if no checkpointer is passed (deepagents_talon/runtime.py:383), so line 844 looks stale. Background sub-agent workers and pending results are in memory only and discarded on restart (README.md:692). Talon is labelled experimental/alpha and not for production (README.md:5; libs/talon/pyproject.toml:14).

risks: API churn and maturity: 21 SDK releases between 0.7.0 (2026-07-29) and 0.7.21 (2026-09-30); 0.7.0 alone listed ~10 breaking changes (empty base prompt, TodoList removed by default, `write_file` overwrites, recursive `delete` tool, backend factories removed) (libs/deepagents/CHANGELOG.md:5,169-186). SDK is classified Beta (libs/deepagents/pyproject.toml:11); dcode 0.1.79 exact-pins `deepagents==0.7.20` while the SDK here is 0.7.21 (libs/code/pyproject.toml:30); Talon 0.0.8, ACP 0.0.12, evals 0.0.1 and sandbox partners 0.0.2-0.0.8 are alpha/0.0.x.

Isolation is delegated to third parties: the SDK provides no OS-level isolation (libs/deepagents/THREAT_MODEL.md:32); `LocalShellBackend` runs on the host (backends/local_shell.py:34-79); every built-in dcode sandbox is a hosted service needing its own account and no local container/VM provider ships (libs/code/deepagents_code/integrations/sandbox_registry.py:38-79); SDK path `permissions` cannot be combined with execute-capable backends (middleware/filesystem.py:1849-1856); the LangSmith sandbox SDK is alpha upstream (libs/deepagents/pyproject.toml:143-144); Talon sandboxing is opt-in, excludes MCP/web tools and is not a multi-tenant boundary (libs/talon/README.md:7,53).

Unattended-run safety: dcode `-n` has no human approvals and can change files and use the network (libs/code/deepagents_code/main.py:2597-2599); the shell allow-list matches only the first token so allow-listed interpreters run arbitrary code, and `all` skips checks (libs/code/THREAT_MODEL.md:449,459,565-569); a project `.env` in an untrusted checkout can run code before any approval (T12, rated High, THREAT_MODEL.md:458,559-563); the local `langgraph dev` server runs with `LANGGRAPH_AUTH_TYPE=noop` (THREAT_MODEL.md:232,453). `--max-turns` counts HITL-resume passes only (client/non_interactive.py:2291-2312); the SDK sets `recursion_limit` 9,999 (graph.py:976), with separate `--timeout` and `--recursion-limit` bounds (main.py:2635-2644,2679-2687).

Resumability and scope: headless dcode always starts a new thread (main.py:1555-1556; non_interactive.py:2822) and `-r` resumes only in the TUI (main.py:6373,6515); sessions are a local unencrypted SQLite file (sessions.py:347-366; THREAT_MODEL.md:197); durable SDK persistence needs a caller-supplied checkpointer (graph.py:968-969); Talon background workers are in memory and lost on restart (libs/talon/README.md:692) and its README contradicts itself on durability (README.md:30 vs 844). The repo is a harness, not a worker service: no job queue or HTTP job API for headless runs, and the `deepagents deploy` CLI used by the deploy examples is not in the tree (examples/deploy-coding-agent/README.md:17).

Network defaults in dcode: update check and auto-update default on (libs/code/deepagents_code/update_check.py:4423-4477), hourly un-checksummed pricing catalog from a mutable branch ref (cost_tracking.py:745-751; THREAT_MODEL.md:552-557), plugin auto-update default on (config_manifest.py:3044-3053); `DEEPAGENTS_CODE_OFFLINE` does not cover the update check (no reference in update_check.py; _env_vars.py:415-421); storing a LangSmith key via `/auth` enables tracing by default (config.py:1736-1804); OpenAI Responses API retains conversation data unless disabled (libs/deepagents/deepagents/graph.py:324-334).

Release and supply-chain integrity: PyPI attestations are disabled (.github/workflows/release.yml:892-893), GitHub releases attach only `dist/*` with no checksums, signatures or SBOM (release.yml:949-961), integration tests are skipped at release (release.yml:820-821); the installer pipes a script to bash and bootstraps uv from astral.sh with only structural checks (libs/code/scripts/install.sh:79-81,1613); dcode depends on pre-release `fastmcp>=4.0.0b4` (libs/code/pyproject.toml:92) and the installer defaults to uv's `allow` pre-release strategy (install.sh:19-20); the `openai_codex` provider reuses upstream-private langchain_openai helpers (integrations/openai_codex.py:27-33); there is no SECURITY.md in the tree.

Model fit: no 'GPT-6.1 Sol' identifier anywhere in the tree (searched `gpt-6.1`, `-sol`); nearest are `gpt-5.6-sol` (libs/code/deepagents_code/tui/widgets/model_selector.py:108,112; model_config.py:1029) and `gpt-6-astra` (README.md:59). Model IDs are free-form pass-through to LangChain, but the `openai_codex` ChatGPT-OAuth provider exposes only a curated list that lacks any GPT-6.x (model_config.py:1026-1044), the SDK has no tuned harness profile for GPT-5.6/6.x (only Codex 5.1-5.3, profiles/harness/_openai_codex.py:27-31), `langchain-openai` is not an SDK dependency (pyproject.toml:22-30) and dcode accepts only pay-as-you-go Anthropic API keys (tui/widgets/auth.py:1093-1095).

Docs, CI and licensing drift: examples reference the removed `deepagents-cli` package (examples/ralph_mode/ralph_mode.py:40); libs/deepagents/THREAT_MODEL.md (2026-03-28) predates 0.7.0 defaults (THREAT_MODEL.md:31,55 vs CHANGELOG.md:175,178) and libs/code/THREAT_MODEL.md:195 describes per-thread DB files while code uses one sessions.db (sessions.py:365); CI has no macOS runner and Windows covers only SDK unit tests (ci.yml:333; _test.yml:351-356); DRBench research evals need an arm64 Docker runner (libs/evals/datasets/drbench-evals/README.md:27-31); UNIFIED_EVALS.md says harbor-index uses LLM judges at :93 but not at :141; libs/evals vendors third-party Apache-2.0/MIT benchmark material inside an MIT tree (libs/evals/harbor_adapters/contextbench/vendor/LICENSE; libs/evals/tests/evals/tau2_airline/LICENSE).
